title: Romanian
description: Everyday Romanian: greetings, family, food, numbers, getting around and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: 'Salut' is casual; 'bună ziua' is the polite hello. Use 'vă rog' (please) with strangers and 'te rog' with friends.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: 'The' is added to the end of a noun: 'prieten' (friend) becomes 'prietenul' (the friend).

units.title: Food and drink
tips: 'I am hungry' is 'mi-e foame', literally 'to me it is hunger'.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Some numbers change with the noun: 'doi copii' (two children) but 'două ceaiuri' (two teas).

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
tips: 'La stânga' means to the left; 'pe dreapta' means on the right.

phrases.e: The station is on the right.
I am going to the airport.

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
tips: Days of the week take no capital letter: 'luni' (Monday).

phrases.e: I drink coffee in the morning.

teach.e: I drink coffee in the morning.

In the morning, I drink coffee.

units.title: Shopping
units.description: Ask for things, prices and how to pay.
tips: 'Aș vrea' (I would like) is the polite way to ask; 'cât costă?' asks the price.

answers: Can I pay with a card?
Can I pay by credit card?
